title: Duplicate records after Airflow retry
description: The campaign ingestion task failed after partially inserting records. Airflow retried the task and encountered a unique constraint violation.
root_cause: The task used a plain INSERT and was not idempotent.
resolution: The load was changed to use an UPSERT and a processed-file control table.

title: API timeout during high traffic
description: The reporting endpoint returned HTTP 504 errors during peak traffic.
root_cause: A slow database query exhausted the application connection pool.
resolution: The query was optimized, an index was added, and connection-pool monitoring was introduced.

title: Duplicate source file processed
description: The same source file was uploaded twice and processed by separate workers.
root_cause: The application did not track processed file identifiers.
resolution: A unique file checksum and processing control table were added.
